# Synthetic File Station fixture provenance

Status: `synthetic-edge-cases-supplementing-reviewed-live-capture`.

This fixture is synthetic and **NOT reviewed**. It was written to exercise the
offline File Station response shape and replay contract; it was not captured
from a NAS and has not been reviewed by 小鑫. The `.deadbolt` and
`!!!READ_ME.txt` names in the IOC variant were injected as synthetic contract
samples. They are not device observations.

The reviewed TS-431K live fixture is stored alongside the existing system fixture; these synthetic cases remain for deterministic IOC and truncation behavior.
Do not use these files as evidence of QTS response behavior, current device
health, or a ransomware event.
